The Chinese characters for Alan

Origin and meaning

Alan is a Celtic name meaning “handsome, cheerful (of uncertain origin)”.

About the name Alan

A classic Gaelic name that has stayed common across the English-speaking world for generations.

As a gift or a tattoo

Because it means “handsome, cheerful (of uncertain origin)”, an Alan calligraphy print makes a thoughtful gift for someone who loves the name or its meaning.
